job.job_description:
HIRING FOR ONE OF THE TOP REPUTED MNC'S!




Job Title: Agentic AI Engineer

Experience: 6 to 10 Years
Location: PAN India
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days
Education: Any Full-Time UG / PG Degree

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Agentic AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy next-generation AI applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic Workflows, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience building intelligent AI agents using modern frameworks and deploying enterprise-grade solutions on cloud platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop Agentic AI solutions using LLMs and multi-agent architectures.
Build and optimize RAG pipelines for enterprise knowledge retrieval and contextual AI applications.
Develop AI workflows using LangGraph, LangChain, and related orchestration frameworks.
Integrate foundation models through AWS Bedrock and other LLM platforms.
Implement prompt engineering, tool calling, memory management, and agent orchestration.
Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Python.
Work closely with product, engineering, and business teams to deliver AI-powered solutions.
Monitor, evaluate, and improve AI system performance, accuracy, and reliability.
Stay updated with emerging trends in Agentic AI, GenAI, and LLM ecosystems.

Required Skills

Strong experience in Agentic AI Development
Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs)
Expertise in RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
Strong knowledge of LangGraph/LangChain/CrewAi
Proficiency in Python
Experience with AWS Bedrock
Understanding of vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search
Experience with prompt engineering and AI agent frameworks
Knowledge of REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native development

Preferred Skills

Experience with Crew Ai, Anthropic Claude, Llama, or similar foundation models
Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, or FAISS
Knowledge of MLOps, AI observability, and evaluation frameworks
Experience with AWS cloud services and server less architectures, CICD Pipelines.

Candidate Profile

6 to 10 years of software development experience.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
Passion for Generative AI, Agentic Systems, and emerging AI technologies.
